description: Game date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 1966-09-02).
NFL season year the game belongs to (e.g., 2024).
Week label: regular-season week number ("1"-"18") or playoff round ("Wildcard","Division","Conference","Superbowl"). Stored as text.
TRUE if the game is a postseason (playoff) game.
Full home team name as it was known that season.
2-or-3-letter franchise ID for the home team (e.g., "KC","SF"). Stable across relocations and name changes.
Home team final score.
Full away team name as it was known that season.
2-or-3-letter franchise ID for the away team. Stable across relocations and name changes.
Away team final score.
Franchise ID of the winning team; the literal "TIE" for tied games (no nulls).
Franchise ID of the betting favorite; "PICK" for pick'em games with no favorite. Blank for 5 games with no recorded line.
Closing point spread for the favorite. Always <= 0 (negative = favored by that many points); -7 means the favorite is a 7-point favorite. 0 for pick'em games.
Spread result from the favorite's perspective: "Cover","No Cover", or "Push". Blank for pick'em games (no favorite) and games with no line.
"Favorite" if the favorite covered, "Underdog" if it did not, or "Push".
Franchise ID of the betting underdog; "PICK" for pick'em games with no favorite. Blank for games with no recorded line.
Posted total-points line (over/under). Blank before ~1979 when totals were not published.
Total result vs. the line: "Over","Under", or "Push". Blank when no line exists.
Actual combined final score (score_home + score_away).
Absolute scoring margin, |score_home - score_away|. 0 for ties.
Stadium name where the game was played.
TRUE if played at a neutral site (e.g., Super Bowl, international game).
Game-time temperature in degrees F. Set to 72 for dome/indoor games. Blank where unknown.
Wind speed in mph. Set to 0 for dome/indoor games. Blank where unknown.
Relative humidity percentage (4-100). Frequently blank due to missing source data.

valid_values_or_range: fog; freezing rain; indoor; rain; rain | fog; retractable (open roof); retractable roof (closed); snow; snow | fog; snow | freezing rain; snow | freezing rain | rain | fog; snow | rain | fog
description: Condition text, e.g. "indoor","rain","snow","fog","snow | fog","retractable (open roof)". Blank when no notable condition recorded.
TRUE if played indoors / under a dome (or closed retractable roof).
